### Phase Q9: make Balanced the production default and promote Balanced-only chroma refinement

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q9-production-presets/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Act on the production-preset clarification by making Balanced, not exhaustive Quality, the default target-rate preset and by promoting the strongest zero-search-cost chroma candidate measured on the current Q8 head: X=3 and B=3 for automatic Balanced target-rate requests at every screened rate. Preserve explicit Quality as the exhaustive reference path, preserve Fast and fixed-quantizer outputs, preserve the historical ChromaHfPolicy enum variant and aliases, add a descriptive preset-wide alias without adding an enum discriminant, and keep explicit manual QM controls authoritative. Build and screen only with native Windows binaries and PowerShell harnesses. Repair the stale Windows AVX2/scalar cbrt mismatch with a shared software-defined operation, materialize Windows conformance link placeholders natively, and preserve the request-scoped inverse-Gaborish invariant when the now-default Balanced controller falls back to exhaustive search by sharing the already-preconditioned transform frame across both controller stages.
